purpose: Rebuild the IP clean-room provenance model on evidence instead of a path heuristic. The previous model collapsed six distinct questions into one classify() call, so it could not answer who authored a file, whether the file is product code at all, and whether its licence is resolved, without conflating the three. This contour separates those axes, measures every git-tracked file and every contributor against them, drives THIRD_PARTY_PRODUCT_CODE, UNKNOWN_PRODUCT_CODE and UNRESOLVED_LICENSES to zero, runs a reproducible similarity analysis over an approved dependency corpus, and prepares the chain-of-title instruments that close the one remaining KPI.
requiredInvariants: No product behaviour is touched. Every path in this contour is documentation, a provenance/evidence script, or the similarity tool. No application source, schema, migration, dependency or CI runtime is modified.

classify() in scripts/ip/build-ip-clean-room.mjs is NOT flipped to declare source first-party. That edit would manufacture a PASS the register itself warns against. The new engine measures provenance from git history and file content; it does not assert it.

AI is recorded as tool and generation provenance only, never as a legal author. Claude, Codex and claude[bot] identities are classified AI_TOOL, and the authorship claim rests on the human principal under ст. 1257 and ст. 1228 ГК РФ, with ст. 1259 п.5 covering non-creative form.

The three orthogonal axes stay orthogonal: code class (first-party product / third-party vendored / generated build artifact / IP governance control), licence resolution, and human provenance. A file can be first-party product code with an unresolved contributor, and the model must be able to say so.

UNKNOWN_PRODUCT_CODE is driven to zero by fixing the engine, not by excluding files. The 20 files first reported as unknown were introduced by merge commit bf24e8bb4 and were invisible to --no-merges; the fallback resolves their real authors.

The similarity result is stated as 'no material undeclared borrowing found across the verified corpus', never as worldwide uniqueness. docs/ip/similarity/dependency-corpus-approval.json records the corpus digest and states the limitation explicitly.

The 48 barrel-file findings are closed by fixing the method, not by an exception list. isReExportOnlyModule() excludes a module only when every statement in it is an import or re-export, and four tests pin both directions, including a negative case on a file with real code.
The legal instruments are complete and ready for signature, with real GIT_HEAD, real commit SHAs, real blob SHAs and real line counts substituted - not templates with fill-in instructions.
verify-first-party-provenance.mjs fails closed. It re-reads gitHead from the summary and refuses to report PASS against a stale artifact.
No production, REG.RU, DNS, database or credential mutation. No new recurring cost.
acceptance: scripts/ip/verify-first-party-provenance.mjs reports PASS on THIRD_PARTY_PRODUCT_CODE=0, UNKNOWN_PRODUCT_CODE=0 and UNRESOLVED_LICENSES=0, and OPEN on UNRESOLVED_FIRST_PARTY_PROVENANCE with the exact file and line counts attributable to the one unresolved contributor.
The similarity run reports status NO_RELEVANT_MATCH over 686 protected files against 19650 corpus files with 0 findings and 0 blockers, and reproduces from the recorded corpus digest.
Removing isReExportOnlyModule() from the similarity tool fails its tests and reproduces all 48 barrel-file findings.
Registering an executed instrument in docs/ip/legal/executed-instruments.json flips the fourth KPI and the gate reports ALL_KPI_PASS, proven by probe.
